title: NestJS GraphQL SWR Caching
author: Zoha
abstract: Implementation and policy guide for stale-while-revalidate (SWR) caching of GraphQL reads in NestJS (code-first) applications, designed for AI agents and LLMs. Covers the one-time module wiring (a forRootAsync cache module, its tokens, storage, invalidation, and context), the five knobs (key, tag, scope, ttl, swr), the @Cacheable/@CacheTag/@CacheScope/@InvalidateTags decorator surface, where to mount caching (service, field, operation, transport), leak safety (default-public scope, per-caller key dimensions, the no-leak checklist), tag-invalidation mechanics (referencesTTL, atomic purge, cardinality, generation prefixes), observability (structured events, per-request trace, metrics), and the driver reality check across async-cache-dedupe, mercurius-cache, Apollo responseCachePlugin, Envelop, and CDN/APQ.
